name: async-compaction
description: Asynchronous (background) compaction: a cheap model summarizes the conversation ahead of time, and at the compaction limit the summary is swapped in with the latest messages kept raw

enabled.title: Async compaction
enabled.description: Off: Claude Code compacts as it always does.

model.title: Compaction model
model.description: Model that writes the summary: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

triggerAt.title: Background trigger (%)
triggerAt.description: The summary starts in the background once the context reaches this percentage of Claude Code's auto-compact limit. Must be below 100: 10 to 95.

level.title: Compaction level
level.description: aggressive: a shorter summary. balanced: the default. soft: a longer summary, and more of the conversation before the trigger kept raw.

prompt.title: Compaction prompt
prompt.description: Replaces the built-in instructions the compaction model follows (what to keep and how to lay it out). The level's length limit and the citation rules are added after it. Empty: the built-in prompt.

promptFile.title: Compaction prompt file
promptFile.description: A file whose text is the compaction prompt; wins over Compaction prompt. hooks/prompts.ts holds the built-in one to start from.

recall.title: Recall tool
recall.description: Keep the summarized messages on disk, have the summary cite them as [m412], and give Claude a recall tool that reads them back word for word when the summary is not enough.
